name: Cursor Black
productConcept: Ghost — zero-knowledge secrets manager for developer teams. CLI-first secret storage, rotation, and audit trail. Teams share secrets securely without environment variables being committed to git.

color-system.twistDescription: Copied from null-signal and adapted for deeper terminal dark. pageBackground #0d0d0d (luminance ~3.5) — deeper than null-signal source. Phosphor green #39ff14 as sole chromatic accent — 1980s CRT terminal monitor green. Body text #d4d4d4 (light grey, not white). Nav surface #1a1a1a. Hero background #0a0f0a — deepest near-black with green undertone.

type-system.twistDescription: Full monospace stack. JetBrains Mono 700 for h1 (clamp 1.75–2.5rem, -0.02em tracking), 600 for h2, 500 for h3. IBM Plex Mono 400 for body (0.875rem, 1.6 line-height). Labels: JetBrains Mono 0.75rem uppercase 0.1em. Two Google Fonts imports. Zero serif fonts.

motion-system.twistDescription: Typewriter + glitch system. 30ms per character for typewriter. Cursor blink 1s step-end infinite. Glitch-shift ±2px at 0.1s step-start. RGB-split with phosphor-green/cyan. Data-reveal 4-step clip-path (0.15s). Phosphor-pulse glow 2s. All easing: step-start. No curves.

grid-system.twistDescription: 80-column constraint — 720px max content width for monospace body. Full container 1200px, 40px padding. Panel system: 1px phosphor hairline border, 0 border-radius, 24px padding. terminal-split: 1fr 1px 1fr with phosphor hairline divider. terminal-cards: 3-col 8px gap. 8px gutters throughout.

spacing-system.twistDescription: All multiples of 8px. Section 64px (8x8). Card 24px (3x8). Item gap 16px (2x8). Grid gap 8px. Nav 40px inline. Character grid aligned throughout.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Terminal cursor + highlight. Hover: color snaps to #39ff14, no background. Active/selected: reverse video (bg becomes green, text becomes dark). Focus: 1px dashed phosphor at 3px offset. Disabled: opacity 0.3, not-allowed. 80ms step-start — snappy, mechanical.

nav-system.twistDescription: Terminal top bar. 48px. #1a1a1a surface. 1px phosphor bottom border (0.4 → 0.8 on scroll). Logo: >_ GHOST in phosphor green. JetBrains Mono 0.75rem uppercase 0.1em tracking. Links snap to #39ff14 at 80ms step-start. Mobile toggle: ≡ symbol.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Terminal/CLI aesthetic documentation. Near-black field, phosphor green single accent, monospace-only typography, panel-based information architecture, cursor states as sole interactive signal, 80-column reading constraint, CRT scanline texture, reverse video selection model.

A_colorContrast.notes: bodyText #d4d4d4 vs pageBackground #0d0d0d — high contrast dark register. accentPrimary #39ff14 vs #0d0d0d — ~12:1 contrast ratio. navText #d4d4d4 vs navBackground #1a1a1a — adequate contrast.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Motion base 30–100ms. Interaction 80ms step-start. Mechanical and coherent. All use step-start or step-end — no smooth curves mixed in.

C_navFontAvailability.notes: Nav fontFamily JetBrains Mono — the primary heading font in assembled type system. Full availability confirmed via Google Fonts CDN.
